label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakExplainCatching
text:
OAK: Pay attention to how the
GYM LEADERS treat their POKéMON.\pThere is more to learn than
strength alone.\pI also study rare POKéMON whose
instincts exceed ordinary limits.\pI call them APEX POKéMON.\pListen to local accounts and
compare three in your LOGBOOK.\pTogether, they may reveal where
an APEX POKéMON can be found.\pBe ready before you challenge one.
If you flee from its battle,\lit will leave for good.$

label: Text_ApexRumorRecorded
text: Rumour recorded.\pCompare three accounts in your\nLOGBOOK to find an APEX POKéMON.\pIf you flee from its battle,\nit will leave for good.$

label: Route11_Text_RivalRumors
text:
{RIVAL}: Hah!
Took you long enough, {PLAYER}.\pI already checked DIGLETT'S CAVE.
Obviously.\pPeople around here keep whining
that the MR. MIME vanished.\pOne guy even says they put up
invisible walls to avoid training.\pSounds fake...
which means Gramps will want it\lwritten down.\pSo listen carefully for once.\pCompare three local accounts
in your LOGBOOK.\pWork out where they point.
That is where you investigate.\pTry not to make me explain
fieldwork twice.\pSmell ya later.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_FatherHeardShadowyFigure
text: My father once told me he\nventured deep into VIRIDIAN\lFOREST.\pHe heard the grumbling growls of\na shadowy figure lurking within.$

label: Route2_Text_ForestComesAlive
text: I'm too scared to enter\nVIRIDIAN FOREST.\pLegends tell of the forest\ncoming alive and ensnaring the\lwicked, never to be seen again.$

label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_AROMA_LADY_NIKKI_Text_PostBattle
text:
The flowers in VIRIDIAN FOREST
are so beautiful.\pThey seem more vibrant and grow
in number the closer you get to\lthe centre of the forest.\pAlmost like something is drawing
them inward.$

label: Text_OakApexTangrowth
text:
OAK: The POKéDEX signal was
almost swallowed by the forest.\pSo the old stories were not just
stories.\pTANGROWTH may be instinct
given root and vine.$

label: MtMoon_1F_Text_AngryPrimalPokemon
text: There's something furious and\nhurt deep within this cave.\pI can feel it losing control.\nMaybe I should head home.$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_EnormousPokemonBargedIn
text:
An enormous POKéMON barged in
through the wall!\pIt was shaking with rage.
Completely unstoppable!\pLucky for us, it rampaged out
the door and headed west,\ltoward MT. MOON.$

label: Route4_Text_TrippedOverGeodude
text:
A hulking PRIMEAPE fled in a
blind rage and took refuge\linside MT. MOON.\pIt was out of control, like its
feelings had boiled over!\pI've never seen one get that
big before!$

label: Text_OakApexAnnihilape
text: OAK: The POKéDEX recorded extreme\nemotional force.\pANNIHILAPE shows what happens\nwhen feeling outruns control.\pBe careful with such power.$

label: DiglettsCave_SouthEntrance_Text_DiglettDugThisTunnel
text:
Well, isn't this a surprise!\pMR. MIME have made themselves
a little home together in\lDIGLETT CAVE.\pThey seem intent on keeping it
all to themselves.\pIt leads all the way to PEWTER
CITY, wouldn't you know!$

label: EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_POKEMANIAC_CHAPLIN_Text_PostBattle
text: The MR. MIME went into DIGLETT\nCAVE and erected barriers.\pIt's like they built their own\nlittle community and closed the\lworld out.$

label: DiglettsCave_NorthEntrance_RockTunnelPitchBlack
text:
This DIGLETT CAVE extends all
the way to VERMILION CITY.\pWatch out for invisible walls
though!\pFeels like something in there
doesn't want visitors.$

label: Text_OakApexMimeSr
text:
OAK: Fascinating. The barriers
registered as a social pattern.\pMIME SR. seems to protect its
group.\pIt turns isolation into
structure.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_TookCuboneFromMother
text: I took this CUBONE away from\nits mother.\pNow it won't even train with me!\nBad investment.$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CuboneCry
text: CUBONE: Kyoo!\pIt keeps crying and looking\naround, as if searching for\lsomeone.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_VengefulSpiritAtopTower
text: It's said that inside POKéMON\nTOWER is a vengeful spirit.\pIt howls in anger over the\nfamily it lost.$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_SpiritSearchingForFamily
text: The tower carries the grief of\nfamilies torn apart.\pSome say one spirit still waits\nabove, calling for the family it\llost.$

label: Text_OakApexOsscythe
text: OAK: I received the tower record.\pOSSCYTHE's readings are bound to\ngrief and memory.\pLoss can shape a life as surely\nas evolution.$

label: Route10_Text_MarkPostBattle
text: When storms pass over the POWER\nPLANT, the river keeps buzzing.\pIt's like nature is feeding it\npower without end.$

label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BAILY_Text_PostBattle
text: Even when the generators quiet\ndown, the air still crackles.\pIt feels like the power is coming\nfrom the sky itself.$

label: EventScript_GymAdjacent_ENGINEER_BRAXTON_Text_PostBattle
text: I saw lightning gather here\nwithout a cloud overhead.\pNo battery can hold power like\nthat. It just keeps coming.$

label: Text_OakApexZapdos
text:
OAK: Extraordinary! That power
reading did not fade after battle.\pZAPDOS seems less like stored
electricity.\pIt is more like a source
that renews itself.$

label: Route20_Text_SeafoamUsedToBeVolcanic
text: SEAFOAM ISLANDS used to be\nvolcanic just like CINNABAR\lISLAND.\pThen one day it all changed at\nonce, and now it's as cold as\lice!$

label: Route20_Text_MarinerPostBattle
text: You broke me into pieces too!\pSEAFOAM was split by a sudden\nfreeze. The caves still hold\lthat cold.$

label: SeafoamIslands_1F_Text_UsedToBeFloodedWithLava
text:
Can you believe this whole area
used to be flooded with lava?\pOne sudden change, and the
whole cave became something else.\pThe deeper you go, the sharper
the cold gets.$

label: Text_OakApexArticuno
text:
OAK: Your readings show a sudden
collapse in temperature.\pARTICUNO changes an environment
all at once.\pAdaptation under pressure...
remarkable.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ScientistsExperimentInMansion
text: After each eruption, the volcano\nleaves new soil behind.\pPlants return stronger than before.\nNature renews itself through fire.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_MoltresRenewingEnergy
text: Our lab studies how fire can\nrestore as well as consume.\pThere are reports of MOLTRES\nstirring life back into scorched\lvolcanic earth.$

label: CinnabarVolcano_3F_Text_BlairPostBattle
text: Fire-types love this pressure.\pDown here, even burned ground\nfeels alive again.\pLike the volcano keeps renewing\nits own energy.$

label: Text_OakApexMoltres
text: OAK: Those volcanic readings are\nalive with renewal.\pMOLTRES does not only burn.\pIt returns spent energy\nto the world.$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_GiovanniOverheard
text: ????: Empty…\nAfter all these years, empty.\pMEWTWO was perfect power.\pPower without waste.\nPower without weakness.$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_GiovanniAddressed
text:
MEWTWO broke free before that
power could be claimed.\pNo matter.
I built that power once.\pI will retrieve it, perfect it,
and make it mine.\pSILPH in SAFFRON has what I need.
A BALL that cannot fail.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_PresidentInterruptsGiovanni
text: PRESIDENT: GIOVANNI, stop this!\pThe MASTER BALL was never meant\nto enslave POKEMON.\pIf you force that power on MEWTWO,\nyou'll bring ruin on us all.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniIntro
text:
GIOVANNI: You're the child from
POKEMON MANSION...\pSo, you followed me from
CINNABAR ISLAND.\pSILPH's MASTER BALL is no mere
product.\pIt is control made mechanical.
Command made perfect.\pWith its plans, TEAM ROCKET will
manufacture the means to reclaim\lMEWTWO.\pCome forth.
I'll deal with you now.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
text:
GIOVANNI: So SILPH's MASTER BALL
will remain out of reach.\pNo matter.\pA BALL is only one way to claim
power.\pSILPH's signal research will
complete my device.\pI will call MEWTWO to ROUTE 7.\pOnce it answers, no LEAGUE,
no child, and no bond will stand\lin my way.\pTEAM ROCKET, withdraw.
We have what we need.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearBoy
text:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pGIOVANNI failed to take the
MASTER BALL plans.\pBut before he fled, he accessed
our signal research.\pIf he combines it with old
CINNABAR records, he may force\lMEWTWO to respond.\pPlease, take this.
If he reaches MEWTWO, you may\lneed it.$

label: SilphCo_11F_Text_ThatsOurSecretPrototype
text:
PRESIDENT: You can't buy that
anywhere.\pIt's our secret prototype MASTER
BALL.\pIt was built to catch any POKéMON
without fail.\pBut a capture is only a beginning.\pIt cannot make a POKéMON trust
you. That part is up to you.$

label: Text_OakApexMewtwo
text:
OAK: The POKéDEX is struggling
to classify that presence.\pMEWTWO's power is not natural
instinct alone.\pIt is a question we created
but do not understand.$

label: CeruleanCave_B1F_Text_GiovanniAfterMewtwo
text:
GIOVANNI: So that is the difference.\pI tried to possess MEWTWO.
You faced it as a TRAINER.\pPerhaps absolute power was never
something a person could own.\pThere is nothing left for me
to take from this place.\pI will return to VIRIDIAN GYM.$

label: CeruleanCave_B1F_Text_GiovanniAfterMewtwoEscaped
text: GIOVANNI: Gone.\pNeither of us could hold it here.\pPerhaps absolute power was never\nsomething a person could own.\pThere is nothing left for me\nto take from this place.\pI will return to VIRIDIAN GYM.$
